errors.evidence: The chart is a pie chart (кръгова диаграма), not a triangular diagram. It is a circle divided into three sectors.
The text labels inside the sectors are white, not black.

The description correctly states that the sectors are equal in size but does not mention the approximate share of each sector (one-third or 33.3%), which can be easily determined visually as requested by the prompt.
